caption:
Jensen Huang's scandal just got the full movie poster treatment.

Delhi Times put the Nvidia CEO on its front page as the star of a spy thriller: leather jacket, chip in hand, a submarine behind him and the title 'The Spy Who Loved Me.' The headline next to it: 'Nvidia is in a sticky situation-chip.' The artwork is labeled as AI imagery.

The real story is no joke. Huang admitted an affair with a woman US officials believe is a Chinese spy, and Nvidia's board met on Wednesday to decide whether he stays as CEO, Reuters reported. No decision has been announced.

Best front page of the year, or did they go too far?
